entity.name: Kartik Hulmukh
entity.description: Solo founder and maintainer of Kairo-Phantom, based in India. I build open-source, privacy-preserving desktop AI tooling whose behaviour can be independently verified rather than trusted. Kairo-Phantom is MIT-licensed and developed in the open.

projects.name: Kairo-Phantom
projects.description: An offline, on-device AI desktop agent that produces a signed, independently-verifiable audit trail of what it does. A sealed runtime mode lets you confirm the agent process made no outbound network connections during a session, and every action is appended to an Ed25519 hash-chained log that anyone can verify offline with the bundled external verifier - tampering with any entry breaks the chain. It includes a prompt-injection screen and a PII guard on inputs, and eleven domain adapters (documents, spreadsheets, PDF, email, code and others) that pass their current fixture/readback tests. Driving live desktop applications end-to-end is an experimental capability under active hardening. Built for people and organisations that need a local AI assistant whose actions leave a tamper-evident, offline-checkable record.
